judgment_calls: The two worked examples under #respect_creators (L1006-1020 and L1022-1033) are each one node because each is a single illustrative block; the dialog inside each is not decomposed.
The three worked examples under #protect_privacy (L1041-1068, L1070-1085, L1087-1106) are each one node; the BAD/GOOD dialog inside each is not decomposed.

The heading-metadata nodes (n002, n010) are separate from the rule nodes they govern; the rule nodes could have needed them, but the rules' authority is already captured by the heading nodes' provides, and the rules themselves do not need the heading to be checkable.
